PLAN "PCOS-Friendly Strength Program (2026-06-01 start)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS

      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m

          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds

          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
